features.name: flow_volume
features.description: Total distinct network bidirectional flows active in observation window
features.interpretation_template_positive: Elevated total active flow volume increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Low or nominal active flow volume decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: packet_volume
features.description: Total aggregate packet count across all flows in observation window
features.interpretation_template_positive: High aggregate packet volume increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Nominal packet volume decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: byte_volume
features.description: Total aggregate payload and header bytes transferred in observation window
features.interpretation_template_positive: Heavy aggregate byte volume increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Low byte volume decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: packets_per_second
features.description: Mean packet transmission rate across the window duration
features.interpretation_template_positive: High packet transmission rate increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Baseline packet rate decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: bytes_per_second
features.description: Mean volumetric byte throughput across the window duration
features.interpretation_template_positive: Elevated byte throughput rate increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Baseline byte throughput decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: mean_flow_duration_ms
features.description: Average flow connection duration in milliseconds
features.interpretation_template_positive: Abnormal average flow duration increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Standard flow duration decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: duration_variance
features.description: Statistical variance of connection lifetimes across flows in the window
features.interpretation_template_positive: High flow lifetime variance increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Uniform connection lifetimes decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: forward_packets_total
features.description: Total client-to-server (forward) packets transmitted
features.interpretation_template_positive: High forward packet count increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Nominal forward packet volume decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: backward_packets_total
features.description: Total server-to-client (backward) response packets transmitted
features.interpretation_template_positive: Asymmetric backward packet volume increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Balanced backward response volume decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: forward_bytes_total
features.description: Total client-to-server outbound bytes transferred
features.interpretation_template_positive: Heavy outbound forward byte transfer increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Baseline forward byte transfer decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: backward_bytes_total
features.description: Total server-to-client inbound response bytes transferred
features.interpretation_template_positive: High inbound byte volume increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Nominal inbound byte volume decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: forward_backward_ratio
features.description: Ratio of forward to backward packets; high ratios indicate unidirectional traffic
features.interpretation_template_positive: Asymmetric forward-to-backward packet ratio increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Symmetric forward-to-backward packet ratio decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: mean_packet_length
features.description: Mean packet length in bytes across all flows in the window
features.interpretation_template_positive: Unusual mean packet size increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Standard mean packet size decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: packet_length_std
features.description: Standard deviation of packet lengths in bytes
features.interpretation_template_positive: Uniform or fixed packet size dispersion increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Natural packet length variance decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: syn_count
features.description: Total TCP packets with SYN flag set in observation window
features.interpretation_template_positive: High TCP SYN packet count increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Low TCP SYN packet count decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: syn_rate
features.description: Rate of TCP SYN packet initiation per second
features.interpretation_template_positive: Elevated TCP SYN initiation rate increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Normal TCP SYN initiation rate decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: ack_count
features.description: Total TCP packets with ACK flag set in observation window
features.interpretation_template_positive: Low ACK relative to SYN increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Healthy TCP ACK count decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: rst_count
features.description: Total TCP connection reset (RST) packets observed
features.interpretation_template_positive: Elevated TCP RST packet count increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Minimal TCP RST occurrences decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: syn_ack_ratio
features.description: Ratio of SYN packets to ACK packets; ratio > 1 indicates incomplete handshakes
features.interpretation_template_positive: High SYN-to-ACK imbalance increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Balanced SYN-to-ACK handshake ratio decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: rst_ratio
features.description: Proportion of flows terminated abnormally with RST flags
features.interpretation_template_positive: Elevated TCP reset ratio increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Nominal TCP reset ratio decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: unique_source_ips
features.description: Count of unique source IP addresses active in window
features.interpretation_template_positive: Dispersion in unique source IP addresses increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Stable source IP cardinality decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: unique_destination_ips
features.description: Count of unique destination IP addresses targeted in window
features.interpretation_template_positive: Broad destination IP targeting increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Standard destination IP cardinality decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: unique_source_ports
features.description: Count of unique ephemeral source ports observed
features.interpretation_template_positive: Ephemeral source port randomization increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Nominal source port usage decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: unique_destination_ports
features.description: Count of unique destination service ports accessed
features.interpretation_template_positive: Broad destination service port scanning increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Focused service port usage decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: entropy_source_ips
features.description: Shannon entropy of source IP distribution: H(X) = -sum(p * log2(p))
features.interpretation_template_positive: Elevated source IP address entropy increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Low source IP address entropy decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: entropy_dest_ips
features.description: Shannon entropy of destination IP distribution
features.interpretation_template_positive: High destination IP address entropy increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Concentrated destination IP address entropy decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: entropy_source_ports
features.description: Shannon entropy of source port distribution
features.interpretation_template_positive: High source port distribution entropy increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Nominal source port entropy decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: entropy_dest_ports
features.description: Shannon entropy of destination port distribution
features.interpretation_template_positive: Dispersed destination port entropy increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Concentrated destination port entropy decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: delta_packet_rate
features.description: Step change in packet rate relative to previous temporal window
features.interpretation_template_positive: Sudden positive surge in packet rate increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Steady or declining packet rate decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: packet_rate_slope
features.description: First-order linear regression slope of packet rates over past k windows
features.interpretation_template_positive: Upward accelerating packet rate trajectory increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Flat or decreasing packet rate trajectory decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: delta_byte_rate
features.description: Step change in byte throughput relative to previous temporal window
features.interpretation_template_positive: Sudden increase in volumetric byte throughput increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Stable byte throughput rate decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: entropy_change_dest_ports
features.description: Rate of change in destination port entropy across temporal windows
features.interpretation_template_positive: Rapidly expanding destination port dispersion increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Stable destination port entropy decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: entropy_change_src_ips
features.description: Rate of change in source IP entropy across temporal windows
features.interpretation_template_positive: Rapid change in source IP diversity increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Stable source IP distribution decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: syn_rate_acceleration
features.description: Second derivative / acceleration of TCP SYN initiation rate
features.interpretation_template_positive: Accelerating TCP SYN arrival rate increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Non-accelerating TCP SYN rate decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: burst_score_delta
features.description: Change in peak-to-mean traffic burstiness ratio across temporal windows
features.interpretation_template_positive: Sharply increasing volumetric burstiness ratio increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Stable or declining burstiness ratio decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: dest_concentration_delta
features.description: Rate of change in traffic destination concentration ratio
features.interpretation_template_positive: Shifting destination concentration ratio increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Stable destination concentration ratio decreased the model's attack-risk score.

features.name: behavioral_anomaly_score
features.description: Unsupervised Isolation Forest perimeter deviation score relative to nominal traffic
features.interpretation_template_positive: High unsupervised perimeter anomaly deviation increased the model's attack-risk score.
features.interpretation_template_negative: Nominal unsupervised behavioral score decreased the model's attack-risk score.
